limitations: The theorem is correct over the real scalars, but its universal-target conclusion is a direct synthesis of the 2026 fixed-pair construction with the classical Banach-Mazur universal embedding into C([0,1]). It therefore fails the originality criterion and, under the value standard used here, is too close to a substitution into an existing construction to qualify as a separate scientific finding.
provenance: Scientific record preserved as failed-audit evidence after a completed mathematical audit dated 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: A single Schur target is additively epsilon-isometrically universal for separable Banach spaces
